sandbox.hint_keys: WASD to walk · Q and R turn the camera · mouse wheel zooms · F1 changes the light
sandbox.hint_pad: Left stick to walk · L1 and R1 turn the camera · D-pad up and down zoom · Create changes the light

prompt.controls: {move} to walk · {camera} turn the camera · {interact} pick up or put down · {build} build · {menu} for the menu
prompt.drop_in: A friend can drop in: {menu} on a second controller
prompt.build_here: {interact} Make a %s here (%d coins) · {rotate} turn · {undo} undo · {build} done
prompt.pack_here: {interact} Pack away this %s (+%d coins) · {undo} undo · {build} done
prompt.sleep_wait: Ready for bed: %s (%d of %d). {menu} for the menu to join in.
prompt.bed_open: The evening is here. When you are ready, {menu} and choose Ready for bed.

menu.title: Our Little Campground
menu.name: Your name
menu.link_code: Link code (only to bring a couch camper to this PC)
menu.link_info: To play %s on their own PC, join this camp there with the link code %s.
menu.hosting: Hosting camp %d. Your friend can join now.

join.full: That camp already has two campers.
join.wrong_version: That camp runs a different version of the game.
join.already_here: You are already in that camp.
join.unreachable: Could not reach that camp. Check the address and that the host is in the camp.
join.host_left: The host closed the camp. Your camper waits safely in their save.
join.bad_link: That link code does not match a couch camper in that camp.
join.host_failed: Could not open the camp for a friend. Is another copy of the game already hosting?

save.too_new: That camp was saved by a newer version of the game.
save.unreadable: That camp save could not be read, and neither could its backup.

deny.too_far: That is a little too far away.
deny.out_of_bounds: That would be outside the camp.
deny.too_close: There is not quite enough room there.
deny.coins: Not quite enough coins for that yet.
deny.pitch_in_use: A guest is staying there; it can be packed away after they leave.
deny.too_early: It is a little early for bed. Bed opens in the evening.
deny.not_here: You are not in the camp.
deny.building: Put the build tools away first.

toast.left: %s headed home. Their camper is safe in this camp's save.
toast.dropped_out: %s hopped off the couch. Their camper is safe in this camp's save.
toast.pad_asleep: %s's controller went quiet. Their camper waits.
toast.linked: You are playing %s from this PC now. It stays yours here.

night.title: Good night
night.quiet: Night %d: a quiet night, nobody stayed.

guest.arrived: %s has come to stay at your %s.
